{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the count of -999 in biomarker_baseline
n_neg999 = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {n_neg999}')

# Check duplicate patient_id
n_duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id values: {n_duplicates}')

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq
n_retested = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique().gt(1).sum()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {n_retested}')"}
